C90B maneuver guide.
Stall Prevention Clean.
Setup
Torque. As Directed. Propeller RPM. 19 hundred RPM.
Stall and Recovery
Announce the first indication of a stall. Autopilot. Disconnect. Nose down pitch control. Apply until stall warning is eliminated. Nose down pitch trim. As required. Bank. Wings level Power. Max allowable
Completion
level off at new altitude and initial heading. Power. Reset
Stall Prevention Partial Flap.
Setup
Torque. As Directed. Propeller RPM. 22 hundred RPM. Flaps. Approach. Landing Gear. Down.
Stall and Recovery
Announce the first indication of a stall. Autopilot. Disconnect. Nose down pitch control. Apply until stall warning is eliminated. Nose down pitch trim. As required. Bank. Wings level. Power. Max allowable. Establish Positive rate of climb. Gear up. At or above V.Y.S.E. Flaps up.
Completion
level off at new altitude and initial heading. Power. Reset
Stall Prevention Landing Configuration.
Setup
Torque. As Directed. Propeller RPM. 19 hundred RPM. Flaps. Approach. Landing Gear. Down. Flaps. Down.
Stall and Recovery
Announce the first indication of a stall. Autopilot. Disconnect. Nose down pitch control. Apply until stall warning is eliminated. Nose down pitch trim. As required. Bank. Wings level. Power. Max allowable. Propeller levers. Full forward. At or above 101 knots. Flaps up. Establish Positive rate of climb. Gear up.
Completion
level off at new altitude and initial heading. Power. Reset
Steep Turns
Setup
Torque. Approximately 700 foot pounds. Propeller RPM. 19 hundred RPM. Airspeed. stabilized between 150 and 160 knots. Flight Director. Off. Stabilize the aircraft on a reference heading and altitude.
Steep turn maneuver.
Roll the aircraft into a 45 degree bank. Autopilot. Disconnect. Power. add approximately 100 foot pounds of torque when the bank angle is achieved. Pitch. Approximately 1 to 4 degrees nose up. Trim. As needed. Recovery
Begin rolling wings level 20 degrees before target heading. Reduce pitch and re trim as required during the recovery. Power. Reduce to original setting
Unusual Attitudes.
Nose high attitude.
Power. Max allowable. Flight controls. Simultaneously level the wings, and pitch down to the horizon. Power. as required to return aircraft to cruise speed.
Nose low attitude.
Power. Idle. Aileron Control. Wings level. Pitch. carefully pitch up to the horizon. Power. as required to return aircraft to cruise speed.
